edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 33 Comm. Cant. Liber I 20

source_text: Finis Libri Primi. Sequenti Libro de eo quod dicitur: Nigra sum et formosa, filiae Hierusalem, prosequemur, Domino praestante. Hactenus de Osculetur me usque ad Aequitas dilexit te, quantum pro viribus, Rufino interpretante, exposuimus. Gloria tibi, Christe, Verbum et Sponsus. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: End of-Book First. In-following Book about that which is-said: Black I-am and beautiful, daughters of-Jerusalem, we-will-pursue, Lord granting...
pass_b_english: End of the First Book. In the following Book we shall pursue, the Lord granting, what is said: [[I am black and beautiful, O daughters of Jerusalem >> Bible:Song of Songs 1:5]]. Thus far, from Let him kiss me through Equity has loved you, as we were able, with Rufinus interpreting, we have expounded. Glory to you, Christ, Word and Bridegroom. Amen.
